disclaimer_p1: The Funeral Services Benefit is a voluntary community benevolence program funded through member dues and offered at the sole discretion of the BMCC Board. It is not an insurance product, is not underwritten or guaranteed by any licensed insurer, and is not a contractual entitlement. Payment of the benefit is subject to available funds, verification of eligibility, and compliance with the terms described in this policy. BMCC reserves the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue this program at any time, with reasonable notice to members where practicable. BMCC, its Board, officers, and volunteers assume no legal liability for delays, denials, or changes to this benefit, and members should not rely on it as a substitute for independent life or funeral insurance. This page is provided for general informational purposes only and does not constitute legal, financial, or insurance advice.
disclaimer_p2: BMCC is not responsible for, and will not reimburse, any funeral or burial costs incurred prior to a member's enrollment date. Coverage applies only to deaths occurring after the membership start date and any applicable waiting period.
disclaimer_p3: This benefit is available only to active BMCC members in good standing and to the household/dependent family members explicitly listed on that member's membership application. Any individual not listed on the household record is not covered, even if related to the member.
disclaimer_p4: This benefit is offered as part of membership only for as long as the program remains valid and active. BMCC may modify, suspend, or discontinue the Funeral Services Benefit at any time, and will make reasonable efforts to notify members in advance if this occurs.
disclaimer_text: Listings in this directory are submitted by community members. BMCC is not affiliated or personally associated with any listed business, and does not endorse, warrant, or assume any liability or responsibility for the conduct, quality, or outcome of services provided by listed businesses. Members are encouraged to use their own judgment when engaging any listed party.

ps_1_p1: Coverage begins 6 months after a membership application is processed and the first payment is received.
ps_1_p2: Only individuals listed on the membership application (the primary member and household dependents) are eligible.
ps_1_p3: The member's dues must be current (see Grace Period below) at the time of death for the benefit to apply.
ps_2_p1: BMCC will contribute up to $10,000 total per membership/household, shared across everyone listed on that membership.
ps_3_p2: If a payment is missed, a 30-day grace period applies from the due date before coverage pauses.
ps_3_p3: Coverage resumes once payment is brought current; the grace period does not extend the benefit amount or waive the original 6-month waiting period for new members.
ps_4_p1: BMCC pays the funeral home or vendor directly, up to $10,000, based on the vendor's invoice or estimate.
ps_4_p2: BMCC does not reimburse cash already paid by the family; the family should contact BMCC before finalizing funeral arrangements so payment can be coordinated directly with the vendor.
ps_5_p1: To request the benefit, the family or next of kin should contact the BMCC office / membership coordinator as soon as possible after the death, with a Membership ID or full name on the application, and a funeral home invoice or cost estimate.
ps_6_p1: The benefit applies only to the funeral/burial costs of individuals listed on the membership at the time of death.
ps_6_p2: BMCC reserves the right to request documentation to verify eligibility before releasing payment.
ps_6_p3: This policy may be amended by the BMCC Board; members will be notified of material changes.
